ceu: ✦ The square between Venus and Neptune

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.
The square between Venus and Neptune creates some tension between your career and your image. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Thank those who helped you get where you are.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.
The square between Venus and Neptune creates some tension between your horizons and your inner life. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Look up a place you would like to visit.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.
The square between Venus and Neptune creates some tension between intimacy and friendships. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Forgive someone in your heart, even without telling them.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.
The square between Venus and Neptune creates some tension between relationships and your career. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Suggest a plan for the two of you this week.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.
The square between Venus and Neptune creates some tension between routine and your horizons. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Help a colleague with something small: it comes back to you twice over.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.
The square between Venus and Neptune creates some tension between romance and intimacy. Hear both sides before you decide.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Surprise someone you love, even if it is just a note.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.
The square between Venus and Neptune creates some tension between family and relationships. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Make a family recipe and share it.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.
The square between Venus and Neptune creates some tension between conversations and routine. A short pause avoids a long argument.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Turn off notifications for an hour and notice the calm that follows.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.
The square between Venus and Neptune creates some tension between money and romance. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Keep a coin in a special place as a symbol of your prosperity.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.
The square between Venus and Neptune creates some tension between your image and family. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Take five minutes when you wake up to decide how you want to feel today.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
The square between Venus and Neptune creates some tension between your inner life and conversations. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Say no to a commitment that wears you out.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.
The square between Venus and Neptune creates some tension between friendships and money. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Listen to a friend's idea with real enthusiasm.
